Frequently Asked Questions

Program Basics

What degree will I earn?

Upon successful completion of the program, you will earn an Associate of Science in Business and Technology (ASBT) from California Miramar University.

How many credits are required to complete the program?

The ASBA program requires 60 credit hours.

How long does it take to complete the program?

The standard program duration is 2 years, though it can be completed in as little as 24 months, even while working full-time.

 
 
What format options are available?

We offer flexible classes designed for your busy schedule, including:

  • Online options
  • Hybrid formats
  • Multiple start dates throughout the year
Where are you located?

Our locations include:

  • San Diego
  • La Puente
  • San Jose

Concentrations

What concentrations are available?
We offer two specialized concentrations:
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Cybersecurity
What does the Business and Technology concentrations focus on?
The Business and Technology concentrations allow you to enhance specifically towards one of two tech pathways: artificial intelligence, or cybersecurity.
 
 

Admissions and Enrollment

What is the tuition cost?
The estimated annual tuition is $14,040 (based on one academic year).
When do classes start?

Classes start every two months, providing multiple entry points throughout the year.

Is there a deadline for each enrollment period?

Yes, our academic calendar consists of six class sessions that span across eight week courses.

Attached are the following deadlines:

  • Summer 1: May 1, 2026
  • Summer 2: June 26, 2026
  • Fall 1: August 28, 2026
  • Fall 2: October 30, 2026
 
 
How do I apply or get more information?

You can begin your journey by clicking the "Begin Your Journey" button on our website, or by contacting our admissions office directly.

Transfer Students

Can I transfer credits from another institution?

Yes, you can transfer up to 45 credit hours from other accredited institutions.

How do you evaluate my previous education?

Our admissions team will work with you to conduct:

  • Transfer credit evaluations
  • Prior learning assessments
  • Review of previous coursework
 
 
Can I transition to a Bachelor's program after completing this degree?

Yes, we offer a seamless transition to Bachelor's programs after completing your Associate degree.

 
 
 
 

Military Students

What support is available for military students?
We provide:
  • Dedicated military advisors who understand your unique needs
  • Monthly in-person lecture options
  • Credit for military training and experience
  • Flexible scheduling for active duty personnel
Can I receive credit for my military training and experience?

Yes, we recognize the value of your military training and experience and will work with you to award appropriate credit toward your degree.

Career and Education Advancement

How will this degree help my career?
The ASBT program provides:
  • A solid foundation in business principles
  • Practical skills valued by employers
  • Learn the fundamentals of AI application.
  • Enhance your tech career in cybersecurity.
What are the benefits of earning an Associate degree before a Bachelor's?
Earning your Associate degree:
  • Provides a valuable credential in less time
  • May increase earning potential while you continue your education
  • Allows you to enter the workforce sooner
  • Provides flexibility to continue toward a Bachelor's degree later
 
 
Can I complete this program while working full-time?
Yes, our program is specifically designed for working professionals, with flexible scheduling options that allow you to balance work, family, and education.
 
 
 
 
Will this program prepare me for today's technology-driven business environment?

Yes, all concentrations include technology integration, ensuring you understand how AI and technology are transforming business, even without needing programming skills.
